tagline.zh: 先证明有可建模余量，再决定要不要建模。
tagline.en: Prove there is headroom to model, before deciding to model.

lede.zh: 虚拟细胞不是一个端到端模型。它是五个可分离、可串联的模块：Cell Passport（细胞背景）、Perturbation Encoder（扰动编码）、State Transition（状态转移）、Assay Emulator（检测 readout 映射）和 Uncertainty & Domain Check（不确定性与适用域）。这个家族按细胞系和适应症把这五个模块productize：每条产品线只承诺它在有底座的细胞系内部能做的排序与预筛，并把不能承诺的部分写进合同。
lede.en: A virtual cell is not one end-to-end model. It is five separable, chainable modules: Cell Passport (cell background), Perturbation Encoder, State Transition, Assay Emulator (biology-to-instrument readout), and Uncertainty & Domain Check. This family productizes those five modules along two axes — cell line and indication. Each product line promises only the ranking and pre-screening it can do inside a cell line that has a data substrate, and writes what it cannot promise into the contract.

promise.zh: 结算口径是富集倍数，不是相关系数。
promise.en: Settlement is in enrichment fold, not correlation.

promise_detail.zh: 一个虚拟筛的价值，等于它把湿实验从「全测」压缩到「排序后测」省下的孔数，减去漏掉真阳性的代价。行业可达区间是把大规模组合压缩到优先验证的 5%–20%。所以每个项目的验收表都有富集倍数、召回率和每个真阳性的实验成本——这三个数才和实验预算对得上账。
promise_detail.en: A virtual screen is worth the wells it saves by turning "test everything" into "rank, then test", minus the true positives it drops. The achievable band is compressing a large combinatorial space to the 5%–20% worth validating first. So every acceptance table carries enrichment fold, recall, and cost per true positive — the only three numbers that reconcile with a wet-lab budget.

title.zh: 五模块架构，映射到七条产品线
title.en: Five modules, mapped onto seven product lines

lede.zh: 模块划分决定了产品边界。最关键的一条：生物状态 ≠ 仪器读数。预测「细胞发生了什么」和预测「CellTiter-Glo 最终读到多少」是两个模型，中间那层必须用配对实验标签单独校准——这就是 AssayEmul-AI 独立成线的原因。
lede.en: The module split is what makes the product boundaries honest. The critical one: biological state is not an instrument reading. Predicting "what happened to the cell" and predicting "what CellTiter-Glo will report" are two different models, and the layer between them must be calibrated against paired experimental labels — which is why AssayEmul-AI is its own product line.

responsibility.zh: 细胞系身份、基因组、基础转录状态、表观调控、基因依赖、药物历史、形态表型、实验上下文
responsibility.en: Identity, genome, basal transcriptome, epigenetic regulation, gene dependency, drug history, morphology, experimental context

responsibility.zh: 药物结构与靶点、CRISPRi / KO / CRISPRa、细胞因子、剂量、时间
responsibility.en: Compound structure and target, CRISPRi / KO / CRISPRa, cytokines, dose, time

responsibility.zh: 扰动后单细胞或群体状态如何迁移；DEG、通路分数、亚群组成
responsibility.en: How single-cell or population state moves after perturbation: DEGs, pathway scores, subpopulation composition

responsibility.zh: 把生物状态映射到活力、荧光、图像、蛋白、分泌因子 readout——必须用配对实验标签校准
responsibility.en: Maps biological state onto viability, fluorescence, image, protein and secretion readouts — must be calibrated on paired labels

responsibility.zh: 训练覆盖不足、跨细胞系外推、异常组合的识别；置信区间与适用域告警
responsibility.en: Detects thin training coverage, cross-cell-line extrapolation and anomalous combinations; confidence intervals and domain warnings

summary.zh: 干湿同精度，可以省掉实验。这一档大部分不是建模，是查库——最容易被忽略的效率来源。
summary.en: Same accuracy as the bench, so the experiment can be skipped. Most of this tier is lookup, not modelling — the most overlooked source of efficiency.

items.zh: 靶点在该系的表达、拷贝数、突变与融合状态（CCLE 直接查）
items.en: Target expression, copy number, mutation and fusion status in that line (direct CCLE lookup)

items.zh: 该靶点在该系是否为必需基因（DepMap CRISPR 直接查，比任何模型都准）
items.en: Whether the target is essential in that line (direct DepMap CRISPR lookup — more accurate than any model)

items.zh: 化合物结构警报：PAINS / Brenk / NIH 干扰子与类药性
items.en: Compound structural alerts: PAINS / Brenk / NIH interference filters and drug-likeness

items.zh: sgRNA 全基因组脱靶枚举与 CFD 特异性打分（穷举，不是预测）
items.en: Genome-wide sgRNA off-target enumeration and CFD specificity scoring (exhaustive, not predicted)

items.zh: 细胞系身份与交叉污染核对（STR / SNP 指纹）
items.en: Cell-line identity and cross-contamination checks (STR / SNP fingerprint)

summary.zh: 只能排序，仍需实验确认，但能把实验量压下一个量级。所有 VC 产品的主战场都在这一档。
summary.en: Ranking only — the experiment still confirms — but it cuts the well count by an order of magnitude. This is where every VC product actually operates.

items.zh: 化合物的转录响应方向与 MoA 归类（须先打赢 L1000 检索基线）
items.en: Direction of a compound's transcriptional response and MoA class (must first beat the L1000 retrieval baseline)

items.zh: 单基因敲低的下游通路——仅限该系有扰动底座覆盖的靶点及邻域
items.en: Downstream pathways of a single knockdown — only for targets and neighbourhoods the line's perturbation substrate covers

items.zh: 同一模态内的 CRISPRa 预测（该系自有 CRISPRa 数据，如 K562 双基因集）
items.en: Within-modality CRISPRa prediction where the line has its own CRISPRa data (e.g. the K562 dual-gene set)

items.zh: 化合物–靶点结合排序（指标要选对：opt_score ρ≈+0.6，binding_confidence ρ≈−0.2）
items.en: Compound–target binding rank (pick the right metric: opt_score ρ≈+0.6, binding_confidence ρ≈−0.2)

items.zh: n² 组合空间的优先级排序与非加和效应候选
items.en: Prioritising an n² combination space and nominating non-additive effects

items.zh: 剂量与时间的插值（在已测剂量-时间网格内部）
items.en: Dose and time interpolation, inside the measured dose–time grid

items.zh: 网络失稳早期预警：方差与 lag-1 自相关在分岔点附近上升
items.en: Early-warning of network destabilization: variance and lag-1 autocorrelation rise near a bifurcation

summary.zh: 已经实测会失败的外推。写进合同的排除条款，而不是藏在脚注里。
summary.en: Extrapolations measured to fail. Contract exclusion clauses, not footnotes.

items.zh: 外推到没有扰动底座的新细胞系——oracle 上下文特征比不给还差
items.en: Extrapolation to a new cell line with no perturbation substrate — an oracle context feature scores worse than none

items.zh: 用敲低数据训练的模型跨模态预测 CRISPRa / 过表达（r = 0.009，等于掷骰子）
items.en: Cross-modality CRISPRa / overexpression from a knockdown-trained model (r = 0.009 — chance)

items.zh: 绝对 IC50 与完整剂量–响应曲线，只排序不给数
items.en: Absolute IC50 and full dose–response curves — we rank, we do not quote values

items.zh: 未经配对标签校准的蛋白、分泌与活力 readout（RNA ≠ 功能）
items.en: Protein, secretion or viability readouts without paired-label calibration (RNA is not function)

items.zh: 时间外推：6 小时转录响应不代表 72 小时活力或长期耐药
items.en: Time extrapolation: a 6 h transcriptional response is not 72 h viability or long-term resistance

items.zh: 从细胞系外推到患者响应；细胞系不等于患者
items.en: Cell-line-to-patient response; an immortalized line is not a patient

background.zh: 肺腺癌 · KRAS 相关背景 · 上皮
结直肠癌 · 上皮 / EMT 背景
胰腺癌 · 上皮与应激背景
background.en: Pancreatic cancer · epithelial and stress context

background.zh: 髓系白血病 · 悬浮细胞
近单倍体遗传筛选模型
肝细胞背景 · 肝毒性代理
相对正常 · p53 完整上皮
成骨肉瘤 · Cell Painting 主力
肺腺癌 · EGFR 敏感突变

lines.zh: 先做 CellTwin 可行性判定

note.zh: 两条不能混的线。跨背景 Perturb-seq 覆盖 A549 / MCF7 / HT29 / BxPC-3 / K562 / HAP1 六条系，这是训练「相同基因扰动在不同背景下为何结果不同」的语料；而化合物与形态底座最厚的是 MCF7 / A549 / U2OS / HepG2。两条线的重叠只有 A549 和 MCF7——所以基因扰动产品和化合物表型产品各自的主力细胞系不同，A549 是唯一四种底座都齐的系。
note.en: Two lines that must not be conflated. Multi-context Perturb-seq covers six lines — A549 / MCF7 / HT29 / BxPC-3 / K562 / HAP1 — and that is the corpus for learning why the same genetic perturbation lands differently across backgrounds. The deepest compound and morphology substrates, meanwhile, sit on MCF7 / A549 / U2OS / HepG2. The two sets overlap only at A549 and MCF7, so the genetic and chemical product lines run on different primary lines; A549 is the only line carrying all four substrates.

title.zh: 七种数据拆分，决定一个数字可不可信
title.en: Seven data splits decide whether a number is believable

lede.zh: 随机 cell split 不能作为主要证据——同一扰动和批次会泄漏，分数虚高。下面每一种拆分回答一个不同的泛化问题，验收报告必须逐项填。
lede.en: A random cell split is not primary evidence: the same perturbation and batch leak across it and the score inflates. Each split below answers a different generalization question, and the acceptance report fills them in one by one.

question.zh: 同一扰动和批次泄漏，容易虚高
question.en: Same perturbation and batch leak; scores inflate

question.zh: 确保测试集不含同一化合物
question.en: Ensures the test set holds no instance of the same compound

question.zh: 测试跨细胞背景泛化——本家族已知最弱的一轴
question.en: Tests cross-background generalization — the weakest axis in this family

question.zh: 检验跨实验室、平台和批次迁移
question.en: Tests transfer across labs, platforms and batches

question.zh: 检验剂量和时间的插值与外推
question.en: Tests dose and time interpolation and extrapolation

question.zh: 检验药物或基因组合的非加和效应
question.en: Tests non-additive effects of drug or gene combinations

question.zh: 用与训练数据独立的真实实验评估
question.en: Evaluates against real experiments independent of the training data

metrics.zh: 评价指标不能只看整体表达 MSE 或 Pearson。至少同时报告：DEG 方向一致率、DE overlap、Pearson delta、扰动辨别分数、通路 AUROC、细胞亚群距离、IC50/AUC 误差、top-k 富集、置信区间覆盖率，以及实验重复给出的性能上限。
metrics.en: Metrics cannot stop at overall expression MSE or Pearson. Report at minimum: DEG direction agreement, DE overlap, Pearson delta, perturbation discrimination score, pathway AUROC, subpopulation distance, IC50/AUC error, top-k enrichment, confidence-interval coverage, and the performance ceiling implied by experimental replicates.

release_floor.zh: 最低上线原则。若深度模型未稳定超过 no-change、平均扰动和线性 / 岭回归基线，该任务只可作为探索性分析，不能作为减少湿实验的主要依据。
release_floor.en: Release floor. If a deep model does not stably beat the no-change, mean-perturbation and linear/ridge baselines, that task stays exploratory and cannot be the primary basis for cutting wet-lab work.

title.zh: Cell Passport 与可建模余量判定

question.zh: 这条细胞系的基线状态、可建模余量和噪声天花板是多少，够不够支撑后续任何虚拟筛？
question.en: What is this line's baseline state, modelling headroom and noise ceiling — enough to support any virtual screen at all?

promise.zh: 所有 VC 产品的地基。没有这一步，后面每个模型分数都没有参照系。
promise.en: The foundation of every VC product. Without it, no downstream model score has a frame of reference.

promise_detail.zh: 交付物是一份八层 Cell Passport（身份、基因组、基础转录、表观调控、基因依赖、药物历史、形态、实验上下文），加上重复孔一致性给出的噪声天花板，加上完整基线阶梯——no-change、平均扰动、线性 / 岭回归、最近邻检索、oracle 上界。如果基线已经贴顶，这条系的这个 readout 就没有可建模余量，我们会直接说不要建。
promise_detail.en: The deliverable is an eight-layer Cell Passport — identity, genome, basal transcriptome, epigenetic regulation, gene dependency, drug history, morphology, experimental context — plus a noise ceiling from replicate-well agreement, plus the full baseline ladder: no-change, mean perturbation, linear/ridge, nearest-neighbour retrieval, oracle bound. If the baselines already sit at the ceiling, that readout in that line has no modelling headroom and we say so.

text.zh: 细胞系身份、可用组学与扰动数据、目标 readout、实验容量
text.en: Cell-line identity, available omics and perturbation data, target readout, experimental capacity

text.zh: 八层 Cell Passport 拉取；与系内及跨背景扰动语料对齐基因版本与标识
text.en: Assemble the eight-layer Cell Passport; align gene builds and identifiers to the within-line and multi-context perturbation corpora

text.zh: 重复孔一致性算噪声天花板；五级基线阶梯；预训练语料按 accession 求交做污染审计
text.en: Noise ceiling from replicate agreement; five-rung baseline ladder; contamination audit by accession set-intersection against pre-training corpora

text.zh: 按占噪声天花板百分比划分可建模 / 需补数据 / 不可建模三档 readout
text.en: Sort readouts into modellable / needs-more-data / not-modellable by percentage of noise ceiling

text.zh: Cell Passport + 基线表 + 适用域声明 + go/no-go 与建库缺口清单
text.en: Cell Passport + baseline table + domain-of-applicability statement + go/no-go and data-gap list

qc.zh: 确认细胞系编号（Cellosaurus / DepMap ID）、批次、传代、培养方式、组学版本与扰动样本对应关系，核对 STR 身份。
qc.en: Confirm cell-line identifiers (Cellosaurus / DepMap ID), batch, passage, culture format, omics versions and the mapping to perturbation samples; verify STR identity.

generate.zh: 拉取基因组（SNV / indel / CNV / 融合 / 倍性）、基础转录与亚群、ATAC 与 GRN、CRISPR 依赖、药物历史与形态表型，统一基因版本与药物结构标识。
generate.en: Pull genome (SNV / indel / CNV / fusion / ploidy), basal transcriptome and subpopulations, ATAC and GRN, CRISPR dependency, drug history and morphology; unify gene builds and compound structure identifiers.

calibrate.zh: 计算重复孔噪声天花板，跑五级基线阶梯，并按 accession 集合求交完成预训练语料污染审计，判定写成原文而非脚注。
calibrate.en: Compute the replicate-well noise ceiling, run the five-rung baseline ladder, and complete the contamination audit by accession set-intersection — recording the verdict verbatim rather than as a footnote.

select.zh: 按占噪声天花板百分比给出每个 readout 的可建模余量，划分可建模 / 需补数据 / 不可建模三档并注明缺口类型。
select.en: Express each readout's headroom as a percentage of the noise ceiling and sort into modellable / needs-more-data / not-modellable, naming the type of gap.

output.zh: 输出版本化 Cell Passport、基线得分表、适用域声明、污染审计判定原文与建库缺口清单及报价。
output.en: Deliver a versioned Cell Passport, baseline score table, domain-of-applicability statement, verbatim contamination verdict, and a data-gap list with costing.

loop.zh: 回收首轮实测数据，更新噪声天花板与基线，重判可建模余量并升版 Passport。
loop.en: Fold first-round measurements back in, update the noise ceiling and baselines, re-judge headroom and version the Passport.

exit.zh: 每个 readout 都有噪声天花板和基线得分，go/no-go 有据可依。
exit.en: Every readout carries a noise ceiling and baseline score, so go/no-go is evidence-based.

value.zh: 先证明有没有可建模余量，再决定要不要建模——这一步产出的表比后面任何模型都重要。
value.en: Prove headroom exists before building anything. The table this step produces matters more than any model that follows.

deliverables.zh: 版本化 Cell Passport（8 层）、噪声天花板表、五级基线阶梯得分、污染审计判定、适用域声明、可 / 不可建模 readout 清单与建库缺口报价。
deliverables.en: Versioned eight-layer Cell Passport, noise-ceiling table, five-rung baseline scores, contamination verdict, domain-of-applicability statement, modellable / non-modellable readout list, and costed data gaps.

teams.zh: 药理、体外模型、AI 平台与技术尽调
teams.en: Pharmacology, in-vitro models, AI platform and technical due diligence

scenario.zh: 虚拟筛立项前的可行性判定与预算论证
scenario.en: Feasibility and budget justification before a virtual screen is commissioned

tools.zh: DepMap / CCLE · ENCODE · scPerturb · CELLxGENE · Scanpy · DuckDB
tools.en: DepMap / CCLE · ENCODE · scPerturb · CELLxGENE · Scanpy · DuckDB

direct_substitute.zh: 基线组学、必需性、身份核对

not_promised.zh: 没有底座的细胞系不出替身，只出建库方案
not_promised.en: No substrate, no twin — only a costed data-generation plan

demo_endpoint.zh: 8 层 Passport → 5 级基线 + 4 类 readout
8 层 Passport → 5 级基线 + 3 类 readout
8 层 Passport → 5 级基线 + EMT 轨迹
8 层 Passport → 5 级基线 + 应激通路
~9.8k 靶点 → 5 级基线 + 双基因集
KO 语料 → 5 级基线 + 逃逸通路

use_case.zh: 选择性、毒性、免疫与分化

demo_endpoint.zh: 5 条系 → 5 张 Passport + 覆盖矩阵

subject.en: Client line / substrate to be built

demo_endpoint.zh: 可行性判定 → 建库方案 + 报价

question.zh: 在这条细胞系里敲低或敲除哪些基因值得进湿实验，下游会往哪个方向动、动多大？
question.en: Which knockdowns or knockouts in this line are worth a wet-lab slot, and in what direction and magnitude will the network move?

promise.zh: 系内插值与排序为主；跨背景只在六系语料覆盖范围内声明。
promise.en: Primarily within-line interpolation and ranking; cross-background claims stay inside the six-line corpus.

promise_detail.zh: 主力是共识项加靶点表征残差——共识吃掉大部分方差，表征只解释未见靶点那部分。跨细胞背景的预测只在多背景 Perturb-seq 覆盖的六条系之间做，并且必须通过 leave-cell-line-out 验证；超出这六条系的外推按不承诺处理。每个结果同时报 seen / unseen 状态与占噪声天花板百分比。
promise_detail.en: The workhorse is a consensus term plus a target-representation residual: consensus absorbs most of the variance, the representation explains only the unseen-target part. Cross-background prediction is confined to the six lines the multi-context Perturb-seq corpus covers and must pass leave-cell-line-out; anything beyond those six is treated as not promised. Every result reports seen/unseen status alongside percentage of noise ceiling.

text.zh: 细胞系（须有扰动底座）、候选靶点集、目标通路、实验容量
text.en: Cell line (perturbation substrate required), candidate target set, target pathway, experimental capacity

text.zh: 共识项 + 靶点表征残差预测全转录组位移；因果调控网络给机制解释
text.en: Consensus plus target-representation residual predicts the transcriptome shift; a causal regulatory network supplies the mechanism

text.zh: DE 基因上的方向 / 幅度；leave-perturbation-out 与 leave-cell-line-out；对齐噪声天花板
text.en: Direction and magnitude on DE genes; leave-perturbation-out and leave-cell-line-out; normalized to the noise ceiling

text.zh: 主靶点 + 阳性对照 + 阴性对照 + 通路覆盖，按纤维去冗余
text.en: Primary targets, positive and negative controls, pathway coverage; de-duplicated by network fibre

text.zh: 排序靶点表 + sgRNA/siRNA 设计 + readout + 预期效应量
text.en: Ranked target table, sgRNA/siRNA design, readout, expected effect size

qc.zh: 冻结靶点集、通路定义、评价指标、七种数据拆分与简单基线，明确排除同批次和同扰动泄漏。
qc.en: Freeze the target set, pathway definitions, metrics, the seven data splits and the simple baselines; explicitly exclude same-batch and same-perturbation leakage.

generate.zh: 在系内与多背景扰动语料上预测每个候选靶点的全转录组位移与 DE 集，同时跑因果调控网络的虚拟敲低作为正交证据。
generate.en: Predict each candidate's transcriptome shift and DE set on the within-line and multi-context corpora, and run a causal regulatory-network virtual knockout as orthogonal evidence.

calibrate.zh: 分层评测未见靶点与未见细胞系，在 DE 基因上评方向与幅度，全部换算为噪声天花板百分比并与四条基线并排。
calibrate.en: Score unseen-target and unseen-cell-line strata separately, evaluate direction and magnitude on DE genes, and normalize everything to the noise ceiling alongside the four baselines.

select.zh: 选主靶点、阳性对照、阴性对照与通路覆盖，去除同一纤维内的冗余旁系同源，标出补偿通路。
select.en: Choose primary targets, positive and negative controls and pathway coverage; drop redundant paralogues within a fibre and flag compensating pathways.

output.zh: 输出排序靶点表、guide 序列与 CFD 脱靶评分、培养 / 刺激条件、readout 与预期效应量。
output.en: Deliver the ranked target table, guide sequences with CFD off-target scores, culture and stimulation conditions, readout and expected effect size.

loop.zh: 回收实测 DE 数据，比对预测方向与幅度，更新共识项并替换失配靶点；主动学习同时补进模型最不确定的候选。
loop.en: Fold measured DE data back in, compare predicted direction and magnitude, update the consensus term and swap out mismatched targets; active learning also pulls in the model's most uncertain candidates.

exit.zh: 头部靶点的实测命中率显著高于随机抽样，且四条基线全部被打赢。
exit.en: Measured hit rate among top-ranked targets significantly exceeds random sampling, and all four baselines are beaten.

value.zh: 卖的是排序和减量，不是又一张预测表——每个靶点带 seen/unseen 标记、预期效应量和机制解释。
value.en: What is sold is ranking and reduction, not another prediction table — every target carries seen/unseen status, expected effect size and a mechanistic account.

deliverables.zh: 排序靶点表、seen/unseen 与跨系分层得分、因果网络机制解释、guide 设计与脱靶评分、对照方案、富集倍数对账表。
deliverables.en: Ranked targets, seen/unseen and cross-line stratified scores, causal-network mechanism, guide design with off-target scores, control plan, enrichment-fold reconciliation.

teams.zh: 靶点发现、功能基因组学、CRISPR 筛选团队
teams.en: Target discovery, functional genomics, CRISPR screening

scenario.zh: 文库瘦身、靶点优先级排序、合成致死与对照设计
scenario.en: Library reduction, target prioritisation, synthetic lethality and control design

tools.zh: GEARS · Scouter · TxPert · CellOracle · SCENIC+ · Cas-OFFinder · DepMap
tools.en: GEARS · Scouter · TxPert · CellOracle · SCENIC+ · Cas-OFFinder · DepMap

direct_substitute.zh: 底座内已测靶点的响应查询
direct_substitute.en: Response lookup for targets already measured in the substrate

question.zh: 这批化合物在这条细胞系里表型上像什么、属于哪类 MoA、先测哪 384 个孔？
question.en: What do these compounds look like phenotypically in this line, which MoA class do they belong to, and which 384 wells go first?

promise.zh: 必须先打赢结构指纹最近邻和 L1000 检索，否则不上模型。
promise.en: Beat structural-fingerprint nearest-neighbour and L1000 retrieval first, or no model ships.

promise_detail.zh: 化合物侧最强的对手不是别的深度模型，是这两条便宜基线。我们把它们建在项目第一周，作为验收对象而不是陪衬。模型只有在留出化合物的 MoA top-k 富集倍数稳定超过它们，并通过 leave-drug-out 与 leave-study-out 之后，才进入交付。
promise_detail.en: On the chemical side the real competition is not another deep model but these two cheap baselines. We build them in week one as the acceptance target, not as a foil. A model ships only once its MoA top-k enrichment on held-out compounds stably exceeds them and it passes leave-drug-out and leave-study-out.

text.zh: 化合物库（SMILES/SDF 或已有签名）、目标细胞系、MoA 分类体系、剂量范围与板容量
text.en: Compound library (SMILES/SDF or existing signatures), target line, MoA taxonomy, dose range, plate capacity

text.zh: L1000 签名检索、疾病签名逆转、Cell Painting 形态嵌入与生成
text.en: L1000 signature retrieval, disease-signature reversal, Cell Painting morphology embedding and generation

text.zh: 留出化合物的 MoA top-k 富集与召回；leave-drug-out / leave-study-out；对比两条基线
text.en: MoA top-k enrichment and recall on held-out compounds; leave-drug-out / leave-study-out; both baselines side by side

text.zh: 头部化合物 + MoA 覆盖 + 阳性对照 + 溶剂对照，剂量-时间网格约束
text.en: Top compounds, MoA coverage, positive and vehicle controls, constrained to the dose–time grid

text.zh: 优先板 + 板图 + 浓度梯度 + 判读规则
text.en: Priority plate, plate map, concentration series, read rules

qc.zh: 标准化结构（去盐、互变异构、立体化学）、统一药物与靶点标识、核对 MoA 标签体系，划出留出化合物集合并冻结。
qc.en: Standardize structures (desalt, tautomers, stereochemistry), unify compound and target identifiers, check the MoA taxonomy, and freeze the held-out compound set.

generate.zh: 计算结构指纹与形态 / 转录嵌入，在同批对照内做分布到分布映射，并跑疾病签名逆转检索。
generate.en: Compute structural fingerprints and morphology/transcriptome embeddings, map distribution-to-distribution within the same batch controls, and run disease-signature reversal retrieval.

calibrate.zh: 在留出化合物上算 MoA top-k 富集倍数与召回，与结构指纹最近邻、L1000 检索并排报告，并跑 leave-study-out。
calibrate.en: Compute MoA top-k enrichment and recall on held-out compounds, report alongside structural nearest-neighbour and L1000 retrieval, and run leave-study-out.

select.zh: 按富集排序取头部，同时约束 MoA 覆盖不塌缩，加入阳性与溶剂对照，剂量点限制在已测网格内部。
select.en: Take the top of the enrichment ranking while constraining MoA coverage against collapse, add positive and vehicle controls, and keep dose points inside the measured grid.

output.zh: 输出优先板名单、板图、浓度梯度、读板通道、异常判读规则与超出适用域标记。
output.en: Deliver the priority plate list, plate map, concentration series, readout channels, anomaly rules and out-of-domain flags.

loop.zh: 回收实测表型，更新富集曲线，把假阳性类型反馈到检索权重；主动学习补入最不确定候选。
loop.en: Fold measured phenotypes back in, update the enrichment curve, feed false-positive types into retrieval weights, and let active learning add the most uncertain candidates.

exit.zh: 留出化合物上的 MoA 富集倍数高于两条基线，且头部召回可接受。
exit.en: MoA enrichment on held-out compounds beats both baselines and head recall is acceptable.

value.zh: 把十万级化合物库压到一块板，并且明确告诉你为此丢掉了多少召回。
value.en: Compress a 10⁵ library onto one plate, and state plainly how much recall that cost.

deliverables.zh: 优先板名单、富集 / 召回曲线、两条基线对照、MoA 覆盖矩阵、剂量-时间建议、板图与判读规则。
deliverables.en: Priority plate list, enrichment/recall curves, both baseline comparisons, MoA coverage matrix, dose–time recommendation, plate map and read rules.

question.zh: 预测出的生物状态，怎么变成 CellTiter-Glo、qPCR、流式或 ELISA 上真正读到的那个数？
question.en: How does a predicted biological state become the number a CellTiter-Glo, qPCR, flow cytometer or ELISA actually reports?

promise.zh: 生物状态不等于仪器读数。这一层必须单独校准。
promise.en: A biological state is not an instrument reading. This layer is calibrated separately.

promise_detail.zh: 这是整个家族里最容易被跳过、也最容易造成过度承诺的一层。虚拟细胞预测「细胞发生了什么」；检测模拟器预测「仪器最终读到什么」。要模拟 MTT、CellTiter-Glo、ELISA、LFA 或流式，必须另外学习试剂、批次、孵育时间和仪器对 readout 的映射，而这需要配对实验标签——没有配对标签的 readout head，我们不交付，只出采集方案。
promise_detail.en: This is the layer most often skipped and the one that most often produces over-promising. A virtual cell predicts what happened to the cell; an assay emulator predicts what the instrument reports. Emulating MTT, CellTiter-Glo, ELISA, LFA or flow means separately learning how reagent, batch, incubation time and instrument map onto the readout — and that requires paired experimental labels. Where paired labels do not exist we do not ship a readout head; we ship the acquisition plan to create one.

text.zh: 目标检测类型、仪器与试剂批次、已有配对标签、可采集的校准样本量
text.en: Target assay, instrument and reagent lot, existing paired labels, calibration sample budget

text.zh: 从状态转移层取分子状态分布，构建多任务 readout head
text.en: Take the molecular-state distribution from the transition layer and build multi-task readout heads

text.zh: 配对标签上的校准曲线；批次与时间协变量；leave-study-out 检验平台迁移
text.en: Calibration curves on paired labels; batch and time covariates; leave-study-out for platform transfer

text.zh: 确定可交付 readout、需补标签 readout 与不可交付 readout 三档
text.en: Sort readouts into deliverable / needs-labels / not-deliverable

text.zh: readout head + 校准曲线 + 置信区间 + 采集方案
text.en: Readout heads, calibration curves, confidence intervals, acquisition plan

qc.zh: 核对仪器型号、试剂批次、孵育时间、读板参数、对照孔定义与历史批间变异，确认配对标签的样本对应关系。
qc.en: Verify instrument model, reagent lot, incubation time, plate-reader settings, control-well definitions and historical inter-batch variation; confirm the sample mapping of paired labels.

generate.zh: 从状态转移层取分子状态分布，为每类 readout 建立多任务回归 / 分类头，显式引入批次与时间协变量。
generate.en: Take the molecular-state distribution from the transition layer and fit multi-task regression/classification heads per readout, with batch and time as explicit covariates.

calibrate.zh: 在配对标签上拟合校准曲线，跑 leave-study-out 检验跨平台迁移，报告置信区间覆盖率与实验重复给出的上限。
calibrate.en: Fit calibration curves on paired labels, run leave-study-out for cross-platform transfer, and report interval coverage against the replicate-implied ceiling.

select.zh: 按校准质量把 readout 分成可交付 / 需补标签 / 不可交付三档，为第二档给出所需样本量。
select.en: Grade readouts as deliverable / needs-labels / not-deliverable by calibration quality, with a required sample size for the middle tier.

output.zh: 输出 readout head、校准曲线、置信区间、适用批次范围与新增标签采集方案。
output.en: Deliver readout heads, calibration curves, confidence intervals, the batch range they apply to, and an acquisition plan for new labels.

loop.zh: 回收新批次实测 readout，检测漂移，触发重校准或回退到上一版 head。
loop.en: Fold new measured readouts back in, detect drift, and trigger recalibration or rollback to the previous head.

exit.zh: 每个交付的 readout 都有配对标签校准曲线和置信区间覆盖率，且标明适用批次范围。
exit.en: Every shipped readout carries a paired-label calibration curve, interval coverage, and the batch range it is valid for.

value.zh: 把「细胞发生了什么」翻译成「仪器读到多少」，并且只在有配对标签的地方翻译。
value.en: Translate "what happened to the cell" into "what the instrument reads" — and only where paired labels exist.

deliverables.zh: readout head、校准曲线、批次与时间协变量模型、置信区间覆盖率、适用批次范围、缺标签 readout 的采集方案与报价。
deliverables.en: Readout heads, calibration curves, batch/time covariate model, interval coverage, valid batch range, and a costed acquisition plan for unlabelled readouts.

teams.en: Assay development, high-content imaging, QC and translational research

scenario.en: Connecting predictions to real plate-reader data and cutting validation rounds

5 通道 → MOA 分类 + 应激表型

demo_endpoint.zh: 需配对标签 → 校准方案 + 样本量
demo_endpoint.en: Paired labels needed → calibration plan + sample size

question.zh: 这个化合物在肝 / 心 / 髓 / 肾模型上，有没有需要提前设计对照的毒性表型，以及癌 / 正常选择性窗口有多宽？
question.en: Does this compound show a toxicity phenotype in liver, heart, marrow or kidney models that warrants a control now — and how wide is the tumour/normal selectivity window?

promise.zh: 这是实验前的对照设计，不是毒理放行。
promise.en: This is control design before the experiment, not toxicology clearance.

promise_detail.zh: 我们不出 NOAEL、不出安全窗数值、不替代 GLP 毒理。产出的是「哪些毒性表型有信号、该在首轮体外实验里加哪些对照和 readout」——把毒性发现从化合物进入动物之后，提前到进入板子之前。RPE1 作为 p53 完整的正常对照，用来给出癌 / 正常选择性的相对排序（不是绝对治疗窗）。
promise_detail.en: We do not issue a NOAEL, a numeric safety margin, or anything replacing GLP toxicology. What we produce is: which toxicity phenotypes carry signal, and which controls and readouts belong in the first in-vitro round — moving toxicity discovery from after the animal study to before the plate. RPE1, p53-intact, serves as the normal control for a relative tumour/normal selectivity ranking, not an absolute therapeutic window.

text.zh: 化合物结构、目标器官、参比毒物集、可用体外模型与剂量范围
text.en: Compound structure, target organ, reference toxicant set, available in-vitro models and dose range

text.zh: 器官相关细胞系表型检索 + 结构警报 + Tox21 端点打分
text.en: Organ-relevant phenotype retrieval, structural alerts, Tox21 endpoint scoring

text.zh: 参比毒物阳性对照回收率；三层证据一致性；适用域标记
text.en: Recall of reference toxicants as positive controls, agreement across the three evidence layers, domain flags

text.zh: 毒性表型假设 + 对照毒物 + readout 组合 + 癌/正常配对
text.en: Toxicity hypotheses, reference toxicants, readout set, and tumour/normal pairing

text.zh: 风险排序表 + 对照设计 + readout + 停试触发规则
text.en: Risk ranking, control design, readouts, stop-test triggers

qc.zh: 确认化合物结构与批次、目标器官、参比毒物清单、可获得的体外模型、培养条件与暴露时间。
qc.en: Confirm compound structure and lot, target organ, reference toxicant list, available in-vitro models, culture conditions and exposure time.

generate.zh: 跑器官相关细胞系的表型检索、结构警报（PAINS / Brenk / NIH）与 12 个 Tox21 端点打分，并与正常对照系配对。
generate.en: Run organ-relevant phenotype retrieval, structural alerts (PAINS / Brenk / NIH) and 12 Tox21 endpoint scores, paired against the normal control line.

calibrate.zh: 用参比毒物做阳性对照回收率检验，标记适用域外化合物，交叉核对三层证据的一致性与冲突。
calibrate.en: Test positive-control recall on reference toxicants, flag out-of-domain compounds, and cross-check agreement and conflict across the three evidence layers.

select.zh: 给出毒性表型假设排序，配对照毒物、阴性对照、癌/正常配对与最能分辨该表型的 readout。
select.en: Rank toxicity hypotheses and pair each with reference toxicants, negative controls, a tumour/normal pair and the readout that best separates it.

output.zh: 输出风险排序表、对照设计、readout 清单、浓度与暴露时间范围、停试触发规则。
output.en: Deliver the risk ranking, control design, readout list, concentration and exposure ranges, and stop-test triggers.

loop.zh: 回收首轮体外毒性数据，校准阈值，把漏报表型加入下一轮 readout。
loop.en: Fold first-round in-vitro toxicity data back in, recalibrate thresholds, and add missed phenotypes to the next readout set.

exit.zh: 参比毒物被稳定召回，且每条风险都配了可执行的对照与 readout。
exit.en: Reference toxicants are recalled stably and every risk carries an executable control and readout.

value.zh: 把毒性发现从动物实验之后提前到板子之前，代价是明确写清不承诺什么。
value.en: Move toxicity discovery from after the animal study to before the plate — at the price of stating plainly what is not promised.

deliverables.zh: 风险排序表、结构警报清单、Tox21 端点打分、参比毒物召回率、癌/正常选择性排序、对照与 readout 设计。
deliverables.en: Risk ranking, structural alert list, Tox21 endpoint scores, reference-toxicant recall, tumour/normal selectivity ranking, control and readout design.

teams.en: Safety pharmacology, DMPK, early toxicology, chemistry

rank_then_test.en: Toxicity hypothesis ranking and relative tumour/normal selectivity

not_promised.en: NOAEL, numeric safety margins, regulatory-grade conclusions

title.zh: 耐药、隐性状态与状态转换推演

question.zh: 这条通路离「开关翻转」还有多远，耐药会从哪条支路出来，处理前是否已经存在隐性耐药克隆？
question.en: How far is this pathway from flipping, which branch will resistance come from, and did a latent resistant clone already exist before treatment?

promise.zh: 唯一有机理动力学支撑的产品线。
promise.en: The only line backed by mechanistic dynamics.

promise_detail.zh: 先用化学反应网络理论的亏格判据判断通路拓扑上能不能成为开关——δ=0 就不可能双稳，直接省掉建模。能成为开关的，再算双稳窗口与分岔点，给临界慢化早期预警指标（方差、lag-1 自相关）。这套引擎已有阳性对照：滴定穿过真实分岔点时两个指标峰值约 5 倍。谱系条码数据则回答一个不同的问题——耐药是处理后演化出来的，还是处理前就已经存在并被选择出来的。
promise_detail.en: First a chemical-reaction-network deficiency test says whether the topology can be a switch at all — δ=0 rules out bistability and saves the modelling. Where it can, we locate the bistable window and saddle-nodes and supply critical-slowing early-warning indicators (variance, lag-1 autocorrelation). The engine has a positive control: titrating through a real bifurcation peaks both indicators about 5-fold. Lineage-barcode data answers a different question — whether resistance evolved after treatment or was already present and merely selected.

text.zh: 通路定义、药物与靶点、细胞系、可测 readout、采样频率与谱系条码可得性
text.en: Pathway definition, drug and target, cell line, measurable readouts, sampling frequency, lineage-barcode availability

text.zh: 拓扑开关能力判据 + 双稳窗口与分岔点定位 + 处理前隐性状态检索
text.en: Topological switch-capacity test, bistable window and saddle-node location, retrieval of pre-treatment latent states

text.zh: 滴定阳性对照校准灵敏度；随机置换标签作阴性对照；可逆性 vs hysteresis 判别
text.en: Titration positive control for sensitivity, permuted labels as negative control, reversibility versus hysteresis discrimination

text.zh: 早期预警指标组合 + 采样时点 + 阈值 + 需条码追踪的克隆
text.en: Early-warning indicator set, sampling timepoints, thresholds, and the clones needing barcode tracking

text.zh: 预警 panel + 时序采样方案 + 触发阈值 + 支路假设排序
text.en: Warning panel, time-series sampling plan, trigger thresholds, ranked branch hypotheses

qc.zh: 冻结通路拓扑、药物占位率数据、细胞系背景、可实现的采样频率、单细胞读出能力与谱系条码覆盖度。
qc.en: Freeze pathway topology, target-occupancy data, cell-line background, achievable sampling frequency, single-cell readout capacity and lineage-barcode coverage.

generate.zh: 算网络亏格判断开关能力，定位双稳窗口与鞍结点，把药物占位率映射到网络参数，并在处理前样本中检索隐性耐药状态。
generate.en: Compute network deficiency for switch capacity, locate the bistable window and saddle-nodes, map target occupancy onto network parameters, and search pre-treatment samples for latent resistant states.

calibrate.zh: 用滴定穿过分岔点的阳性对照校准指标灵敏度，用随机置换扰动标签做阴性对照，并用撤药实验区分可逆恢复与真正 hysteresis。
calibrate.en: Calibrate indicator sensitivity with a titration that crosses the bifurcation, use permuted perturbation labels as a negative control, and separate reversible recovery from true hysteresis with a washout arm.

select.zh: 选方差 / lag-1 自相关 / DNB 指标组合，定采样时点与预警阈值，标出不可预警的支路与需条码追踪的克隆。
select.en: Select the variance / lag-1 autocorrelation / DNB indicator set, fix timepoints and thresholds, and name the branches that cannot be warned and the clones needing barcode tracking.

output.zh: 输出早期预警 panel、时序采样方案、触发阈值、耐药支路假设排序与谱系追踪设计。
output.en: Deliver the early-warning panel, time-series sampling plan, trigger thresholds, ranked resistance-branch hypotheses and lineage-tracking design.

loop.zh: 回收时序数据，检验预警是否早于表型翻转，更新阈值与支路优先级。
loop.en: Fold time-series data back in, test whether the warning preceded the phenotypic flip, and update thresholds and branch priorities.

exit.zh: 预警指标在实测时序中先于表型变化上升，且阴性对照不报警。
exit.en: Warning indicators rise before the phenotypic change in the measured series, and the negative control stays silent.

value.zh: 输出的是可采样的早期预警指标和时点，不是一句「可能会耐药」。
value.en: The output is samplable early-warning indicators and timepoints, not the sentence "resistance may develop".

deliverables.zh: 开关能力判据、双稳窗口、预警指标组合、采样时点表、阴阳性对照方案、隐性状态与克隆选择证据、支路假设排序。
deliverables.en: Switch-capacity verdict, bistable window, indicator set, timepoint table, positive and negative controls, latent-state and clonal-selection evidence, ranked branch hypotheses.

teams.zh: 转化研究、耐药机制、临床前药理
teams.en: Translational research, resistance mechanism, preclinical pharmacology

scenario.zh: 耐药机制假设生成、早期预警指标设计与克隆演化追踪
scenario.en: Resistance-mechanism hypothesis generation, early-warning design, clonal-evolution tracking

question.zh: n² 的组合空间里，先测哪 96 个孔，以及每个组合要配什么单药对照和浓度矩阵？
question.en: Out of an n² combination space, which 96 wells go first — and what single-agent controls and concentration matrix does each need?

promise.zh: 排序 + 对照设计，不出协同系数预测值。
promise.en: Ranking and control design; no predicted synergy coefficients.

promise_detail.zh: 协同性的绝对数值（Bliss / Loewe 分数）对实验条件极度敏感，预测出来也不可信。我们只做两件事：把组合空间排序，以及为每个入选组合设计能真正分辨协同与相加的单药对照与浓度矩阵——后者往往才是组合实验失败的真实原因。基线是「两个单药都强」，这条基线很强，必须先打赢。
promise_detail.en: Absolute synergy values (Bliss / Loewe) are extremely sensitive to assay conditions, so a predicted one is not trustworthy. We do two things: rank the combination space, and design for each selected pair the single-agent controls and concentration matrix that can actually separate synergy from additivity — which is usually the real reason combination experiments fail. The baseline is "both single agents are strong", and it is a strong one that must be beaten first.

text.zh: 单药清单与浓度范围、目标细胞系、组合假设来源、板容量
text.en: Single-agent list and concentration ranges, target line, source of combination hypotheses, plate capacity

text.zh: 通路互补性 + 单药响应 + 双基因非加和先验的联合排序
text.en: Joint ranking from pathway complementarity, single-agent response and dual-gene non-additivity priors

text.zh: 留出组合的 top-k 富集；unseen-combination 拆分；与「两个单药都强」基线对比
text.en: Top-k enrichment on held-out combinations, an unseen-combination split, and comparison to the both-strong baseline

text.zh: 头部组合 + 单药对照 + 浓度矩阵 + 预期无协同的阴性组合
text.en: Top pairs, single-agent controls, concentration matrix, and negative pairs expected to show no synergy

text.zh: 组合板图 + 浓度矩阵 + 协同判读规则 + 重复设计
text.en: Combination plate map, concentration matrix, synergy read rules, replicate design

qc.zh: 冻结单药清单与浓度范围、细胞系背景、板容量与重复数，划出留出组合集合并确认无同对泄漏。
qc.en: Freeze the single-agent list and ranges, cell-line background, plate capacity and replicate count; hold out a combination set and confirm no same-pair leakage.

generate.zh: 用通路互补性、单药响应谱与双基因非加和先验，对 n² 空间做联合排序并标注机制假设。
generate.en: Rank the n² space jointly from pathway complementarity, single-agent response profiles and dual-gene non-additivity priors, annotating the mechanistic hypothesis.

calibrate.zh: 在留出组合上算 top-k 富集，跑 unseen-combination 拆分，并与「两个单药都强」这条强基线并排报告。
calibrate.en: Compute top-k enrichment on held-out combinations, run the unseen-combination split, and report beside the strong both-strong baseline.

select.zh: 取头部组合，为每个组合配单药对照与浓度矩阵，加入预期无协同的阴性组合与重复安排。
select.en: Take the top pairs, give each single-agent controls and a concentration matrix, and add negative pairs and a replicate layout.

output.zh: 输出组合板图、浓度矩阵、单药对照位、协同判读规则与重复设计。
output.en: Deliver the combination plate map, concentration matrix, single-agent control wells, synergy read rules and replicate design.

loop.zh: 回收协同实测，更新先验权重，剔除被证伪的通路互补假设。
loop.en: Fold measured synergy back in, update prior weights, and retire falsified complementarity hypotheses.

exit.zh: 头部组合的协同命中率高于「两个单药都强」基线，且对照能分辨协同与相加。
exit.en: Synergy hit rate among top pairs beats the both-strong baseline, and the controls separate synergy from additivity.

value.zh: 组合实验最常见的失败不是选错组合，是对照和浓度矩阵设计不出协同——我们两件事都交付。
value.en: The usual failure in combination work is not picking the wrong pair but a control and concentration design that cannot reveal synergy. We deliver both.

deliverables.zh: 组合排序表、富集曲线与基线对比、组合板图、浓度矩阵、单药与阴性对照、判读规则与重复设计。
deliverables.en: Combination ranking, enrichment curves against baseline, plate map, concentration matrix, single-agent and negative controls, read rules and replicate design.

teams.en: In-vitro pharmacology, translational research, combination therapy
